function.name: prepare_food_get_recipe

food_type.description: The type of food for the recipe.

message.content:
Sure! The most common “machine” for baking a chocolate cake is a standard electric oven.  
If you’re looking for something a bit more specialized, you could also consider:

* **Convection oven** – heats more evenly and can reduce baking time.  
* **Toaster oven** – great for small batches or when you don’t have a full-size oven.  
* **Cake maker / cake pan** – a dedicated cake pan (often silicone or metal) helps shape and bake the cake evenly.  

All of these will give you a delicious chocolate cake—just follow your favorite recipe and adjust the temperature/time accordingly.
